LanguageData.TM_FleshGolem_Workstation.description:
A dormant flesh golem. Flesh golems are a bipedal-like mass of organic matter, mostly comprised of body parts from deceased creatures. The flesh golem is a fearsome combatant with a variety of attacks and abilities that further increase its lethality. In addition to basic tasks such as hauling and cleaning, the flesh golem is able to use attached cleavers to harvest trees or plants.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The flesh golem recharges energy slowly on its own but supplying it with fresh meat will increase the recharge speed.
LanguageData.TM_FleshGolem_Workstation.label: dormant flesh golem
LanguageData.TM_HollowGolem_Workstation.description:
A dormant hollow golem. Hollow golems are a combination of condensed mana tethered and protected by various pieces of armor. In it's dormant form, the hollow golem appears as an empty suite of armor. This golem draws on ambient mana to fuel itself which can cause an overall reduction, even negative, mana regeneration rates for mages. This reduction is combined with existing mages and paracyte thorn bushes. In addition to basic tasks such as hauling and cleaning, the hollow golem can be outfitted to provide light, increase research, and act as a mortar system. Being a creature of animated mana, they are able to harness multiple forms of magical energy, without suffering from human frailties.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The hollow golem recharges energy slowly on its own but may be toggled to receive mana from nearby mages.
LanguageData.TM_HollowGolem_Workstation.label: dormant hollow golem
LanguageData.TM_MaharalGolem_Workstation.description:
Maharal golems apply the basic principles of golemancy and are simple constructs of clay wrapped in leather. The maharal golem is capable of basic tasks and defense. In its dormant form, the maharal golem can be enhanced to provide low amounts of heat and energy.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The maharal golem recharges energy slowly on its own. This golem takes up to 5 seconds to activate.
LanguageData.TM_MaharalGolem_Workstation.label: dormant maharal golem
LanguageData.TM_MechaGolem_Workstation.description:
A dormant mecha-golem. Mecha golem design combines industrial engineering with magical attributes to bring to life a robotic construct. This golem can tap into existing power grids to speed charge rate. In addition to basic tasks such as hauling and cleaning, the mecha golem can be equipped with a mining laser to rapidly drill through mine-able rock. Mecha golems combine both industrial and simple weaponry and armor into its arsenal.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The mecha-golem recharges energy slowly on its own but access to power sources will increase the recharge speed. The golem may also provide energy to an electrical grid when there is an electrical deficit.
LanguageData.TM_MechaGolem_Workstation.label: dormant mecha-golem
LanguageData.TM_SilkGolem_Workstation.description:
Silk golems apply the basic principles of golemancy and are simple constructs of cloth and silk that makes their form undefined yet pliable. The silk golem's main function is wardening and social tasks, but their unprotected form makes them a poor choice for hard labor or combat.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The silk golem recharges energy slowly on its own. This golem takes up to 2 seconds to activate.
LanguageData.TM_SilkGolem_Workstation.label: dormant silk golem
LanguageData.TM_StoneGolem_Workstation.description:
Stone golems apply the basic principles of golemancy and are simple constructs of rock and stone fashioned into humanoid shape. Though simple and inexpensive, the stone golem is unrefined and relies heavily on magical runes for mobility. The material weight and reliance on magical power for animation make the stone golem slow, but difficult to destroy. In its dormant form, the stone golem can be enhanced with a rock compactor, which is an automated process that crushes rock and shapes it into bricks. This process requires energy and the stone chunks to be deposited into the golem.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The stone golem recharges energy slowly on its own. This golem takes up to 10 seconds to activate.
LanguageData.TM_StoneGolem_Workstation.label: dormant stone golem
LanguageData.TM_StrawGolem_Workstation.description:
Straw golems apply the basic principles of golemancy and are simple constructs of wood and hay fashioned into humanoid shape. Simple and inexpensive, the straw golem is at home in the fields, able to seed new crops. Its light weight and flexible construction material make it an excellent golem for keeping the colony free of debris, but is extremely flammable. The straw golem increases nearby plant growth in both active and dormant forms
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The straw golem recharges energy slowly on its own. This golem takes up to 3 seconds to activate.
LanguageData.TM_StrawGolem_Workstation.label: dormant straw golem

LanguageData.TM_WoodGolem_Workstation.description:
Wood golems apply the basic principles of golemancy and are simple constructs of wood, stone, and steel fashioned into a hollowed spherical shape. The wood golem's frame encases a magical core. The wood golem is able to perform basic crafting, animal care, cooking, and drug synthesis. The wood golem's simple and inexpensive construction provide it to fill many roles in the early stages of a colony, but it is inefficient and easily destroyed.
While dormant, the golem may be modified or upgraded. The wood golem recharges energy slowly on its own. This golem takes up to 4 seconds to activate.
LanguageData.TM_WoodGolem_Workstation.label: dormant wood golem
